findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: pulse, ai_models_by_task, product_recalls, topic_demand, sources_status, keys_trial · Private data: explain, token_verdict, polymarket_leaderboard, base_balance, token_risk, ai_models, ai_cheapest, defi_yields, oracle_forecast, polymarket_edge, oracle_track_record, keys_trial · Public sink: token_verdict, options_summary, treasury_auctions, defi_yields, keys_trial, carry_spot_perp · Destructive: sources_status.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: pulse, ai_models_by_task, product_recalls, topic_demand, sources_status, keys_trial · Private data: explain, token_verdict, polymarket_leaderboard, base_balance, token_risk, ai_models, ai_cheapest, defi_yields, oracle_forecast, polymarket_edge, oracle_track_record, keys_trial · Public sink: token_verdict, options_summary, treasury_auctions, defi_yields, keys_trial, carry_spot_perp · Destructive: sources_status

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
